subject: [PATCH v5 21/36] proc/kcore: include private-node RAM in the kcore RAM map

2026-07-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses an issue where private-node RAM is truncated from /proc/kcore due to the kcore_ram_list bounds being set at the highest pfn in N_MEMORY. The change includes N_MEMORY_PRIVATE nodes in the scan boundary, allowing a debugger to read private-node memory like any other RAM.
